why: A preset that never sets its amp envelope plays the toolkit's default one, the 'default left in' finding of the patch research (34 % of plugin bells): every such patch has the same attack and release whatever its kind. Written for the house's text patches, where a key left at its default is not written; an engine that owns its envelope (organ, piano, tine, reed, the bass engine) is left out. Measured on the house banks: 0 of 2,086 Tabula presets after reading the 66 first hits (organs, pianos and per-slot envelopes, all correct).
